description: Shared PDF annotation thread card used by both TmPdfAnnotationThreadPanel and TmPdfAnnotatorPanel: a colored badge, plain-case kind label, first-comment preview, author and time, page reference, neutral reply count, a success-subtle resolved chip, and a chevron over an expandable detail region.

parameters.name: ThreadId
parameters.description: Stable thread identifier, exposed as data-thread-id.

parameters.name: Number
parameters.description: Ordinal number rendered in the colored badge.

parameters.name: Color
parameters.description: CSS color for the badge background. When null the primary token is used.

parameters.name: KindLabel
parameters.description: Localized annotation kind label rendered in normal casing, when present.

parameters.name: AuthorName
parameters.description: Author display name of the initial comment, when known.

parameters.name: CreatedAt
parameters.description: Creation timestamp of the initial comment (absolute until phase 9).

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: Page number the thread is anchored to.

parameters.name: ReplyCount
parameters.description: Number of replies (comments after the first) in the thread.

parameters.name: Resolved
parameters.description: Whether the thread is resolved; renders the success-subtle chip.

parameters.name: Selected
parameters.description: Whether the thread is selected (expanded detail, chevron up).

parameters.name: OnToggle
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the header is clicked to toggle selection.

parameters.name: DetailId
parameters.description: DOM id of the expandable detail region, referenced by the header's aria-controls.

parameters.name: HeaderTestId
parameters.description: Test id of the header button (panel contract, e.g. pdf-annotation-thread).

parameters.name: DetailTestId
parameters.description: Test id of the detail region (panel contract, e.g. pdf-annotation-detail).

parameters.name: ChildContent
parameters.description: Detail content rendered while the thread is selected.
